payload.title: Community LLM Inference Kernel Optimization
payload.summary: > This article synthesizes multiple technical articles from the Zhihu community, distilling core knowledge of GPU kernel optimization for LLM inference scenarios. > It covers FlashAttention evolution, KV Cache optimization, MoE GEMM, quantization kernels, linear attention, > and DeepSeek model inference optimization practices. > > See the "Information Sources" section at the end of the article for the list of source articles.

sections.heading: FlashAttention Principles and Evolution (v1 to v4)
sections.gist: The core optimization motivation of FlashAttention is to avoid writing the complete attention matrix to HBM.

sections.heading: Paged KV Cache Mechanism and Optimization

sections.gist: GEMM optimization for MoE (Mixture of Experts) layers requires consideration of parallelism strategies:

sections.heading: FP8/FP4 Quantization Kernels
sections.gist: In MLPerf Inference v5.0, both AMD and NVIDIA adopted the OCP FP8-e4m3 format:

sections.heading: Linear Attention & GDN Kernel Optimization
sections.gist: Linear attention reduces standard attention's O(N²) complexity to O(N) by decomposing softmax(QK^T)V into Q(K^T V), avoiding explicit computation of the N×N attention matrix.

sections.heading: DeepSeek Model Inference Optimization Practices
sections.gist: NVIDIA uses TensorRT-LLM to optimize DeepSeek-R1 (671B parameters) on B200.

sections.heading: GPU Profiling Tools
sections.gist: NVIDIA's official profiling tool, consisting of CLI (`nsys`) and GUI components: - `nsys profile` sampling generates `.nsys-rep` files - GUI displays timeline, kernel calls, memory transfers, etc.
